prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Your Pet is Arriving Soon!", "Try out pet commands and play in this interactive sandbox preview while we prepare your pet.", "Interactive Sandbox Preview"]
1: ["Desktop Pet Quick Controls", "Right-click your pet anytime to hide, summon, or talk to it. Press Alt+P to open controls.", "Right-click desktop pet for quick actions", "Hotkey: Alt+P"]
2: ["Photo Quality & Framing Inspector", "Check photo lighting and angle badges to ensure best quality custom generation.", "Upload Front & Side Views", "Lighting Verified"]
3: []
4: ["Signing into an existing account? Your saved desktop pets will be restored automatically."]
5: ["Creating Your Custom Companion", "Generating 3D model, desktop animations, and AI voice responses...", "Estimated arrival: ~2 minutes. Feel free to minimize this window."]
6: ["Select Your Pet Experience", "Choose 'Custom Creator' to generate from photos, or 'Instant Companion' to adopt a ready-made pet right away.", "You can add more pets to your desktop anytime later."]
7: ["Minimize this window anytime. We'll send a desktop alert the moment your pet is ready!"]
8: ["Welcome Your Desktop Companion!", "Complete onboarding now to unlock an exclusive Golden Collar starter accessory for your pet.", "Starter Gift Unlocked: Golden Collar"]
9: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Your adoption certificate is officially sealed and saved to your account.", "Official Companion Sealed"]

verdicts.problem: Mentions gifts/free extras and uses exclusive items to push immediate onboarding completion
